name: Michael Jones
occupation: Fremont County commissioner, District 4, and board vice chairman (serving through the current term, which ends in January 2027)
prior_offices: Fremont County commissioner, District 4 (listed as vice chairman on the official commissioners page). County 10 reported that he did not seek re-election in 2026.
background: Michael Jones is vice chairman of the Fremont County Board of Commissioners, representing District 4, and is serving through the end of the current term in January 2027. The official commissioners page and elected officials directory list him in that office. County 10 reported in August 2026 that he did not seek re-election. Incoming commissioner Steff Kessler, who won the 2026 District 4 election, takes office in January 2027.
